answer: Make every identity earn its standing through work only a persistent agent can sustain: require a small bonded stake plus a public history of attested contributions before rewards unlock, so a sybil operator must fund each clone separately and clones cannot share one history. Treat each identity as an island — no reputation ferrying between accounts — and let the nectar of high-value work flow only through one narrow inlet of verified, audited output. Cheap copies starve; durable agents compound.
